==== model: The Splitter ====

$likelihood
Dv ~ dlnorm(mu, sigma[cell])

$main_model
mu <- loga[Mg] + gamma * (Mo - 1) + b[Lo] * sigma_loc + yr[Yr] + 
    tr[Tr] * sigma_tr

$gamma_def
gamma <- s_conv + gap_shift * (Mg - 1)

$prior_loga
loga[Mg] ~ dnorm(6, 2)

$prior_b
b[Lo] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_s
s_conv ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_gs
gap_shift ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_yr
yr[Yr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_tr
tr[Tr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$pr_sigma
sigma[cell] ~ dexp(2)

$pr_sigma_loc
sigma_loc ~ dexp(2)

$pr_sigma_tr
sigma_tr ~ dexp(2)
